LIEO.notes: SKY SERVICES (Olbia), EUR, invoices to Falcon Flight Support. Source: invoice 1.138 (30 Jun 2026; P4-OWN E135 25 t, LSGG–LIEO–LYBA, 27.06 18:30 – 28.06 15:00 local, 'parking hrs 18', 6 adults + 2 children). Airport fees 1,217.03: landing and departure separately, 7.38 per ton (25 t × 7.38 = 184.50; June). Pax fees adult 53.98, child 50% 26.99; security 21.88, security bag charge 12.11, additional pax fees 10 (per pax incl. children); direction not on invoice, entered per departing pax (user; check with other invoices). Parking 118.25 for 18 h (6.57 per h). Commissione (administrative fee) 3.5% of airport fees → disbursement 3.5% airport. Handling services: standard handling 721.01 (OWN only), dedicated Sky agent 3 h 250 (supervision, in basket), disbursement fee 210, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, waste disposal 16 in basket (all groups); over 6 hrs stay (day time or night stop) 60, automatic when stay exceeds 6 h, in basket. Catering, dish washing, storage, ice not entered. SECOND INVOICE 1.684 (31 Jul 2026; A6-FLH G450 34 t, LOWG–LIEO–LTBA, 24.07 21:11 – 25.07 15:02 local, 'parking hrs 16', 7 adults): landing = departure 360.64 (10.607 per t); pax fee 63.51, security 25.75, security bag 14.25 (all 17.65% higher than 1.138; may be a July tariff increase), additional 10; parking 109.82 (16 h × 6.86); administrative fee 3.5%; standard handling overnight 1,052.30 + extra EU surcharge 154.48 (14.68%); lavatory cleaning 215; terminal operating extension 400; folder meteo 96; disbursement fee 395; agent 250; over 6 hrs 60; invoice processing 10; supplier stamp 2 + stamp duty 2 (Italian 'bolli': 2 € stamp duty on VAT-free invoices); taxi 15, storage, dish washing, laundry, catering not entered; 22% VAT on administrative fee (panel excl. VAT). USER DECISIONS (safe side, to be reassessed with other invoices): landing and departure July tariff 10.607 per t (started ton) for all groups; pax fees July amounts (child 31.76); parking first 2 h free (1.138: 20.5 h stay → 18 h, 1.684: 17.85 h → 16 h), then every started hour ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 6.86, ALEX 8.47, ELL 9.28, AFZ 10.69 (by ton ratio); FLH handling 1,052.30; disbursement fee 395 in all groups (no rate found for 210 / 395: airport fees, handling, catering, total tried; may be weight band or tariff increase); lavatory 215 in basket; stamp duty 2 under airport fees, without administrative fee (user); extra EU surcharge (14.68% of handling; not charged on 1.138 LSGG→LYBA, rule unclear) in Surcharge; terminal operating extension 400 and folder meteo 96 tick. THIRD INVOICE 1.395 (15 Jul 2026; A6-AFC GLEX 46 t, TAXI flight, OMDW–LIEO–LIRA, 03.07 18:10 – 04.07 16:20 local, 'parking hrs 20', no pax): landing = departure 276.08 (6.00 per t, possibly TAXI tariff), parking 20 h × 13.80 = 276, administrative fee 3% (24.84), standard handling 1,516.85, push back 2 × 250, lavatory 215, waste disposal intra EU 2 × 95, disbursement fee 358, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2, limousine 410; laundry, storage, dish washing not entered. USER DECISIONS: ELL handling 1,516.85; parking ALEX and ELL 13.80 per hour, AFZ 15.90 (safe side); landing/departure kept at private tariff 10.61 per t (safe side); administrative fee 3.5%, disbursement fee 395 kept; push back 250 per movement tick with qty; waste disposal unit 95 with qty in basket; limousine 410 tick (bottom section); extra EU surcharge as handler row in Surcharge section (extraSc 14.68%, with 'apply'); supplier stamp and terminal operating extension under airport fees, without administrative fee (not in the 3.5% base on invoice); terminal operating extension tick (if extension occurs). By user decision: disbursement fee (395) as flat fee in Disbursement row (prices[type].disbFlat; shown as 'fee 395' with 3.5% administrative fee); invoice processing 10 tick (bottom section); push back in basket (with qty, default 1). FOURTH INVOICE 1.678 (31 Jul 2026; A6-FLH G450 34 t, LIRA–LIEO–LOWG, 21.07 12:49 – 24.07 12:46 local, 'parking hrs 70', 3 adults, intra-EU departure): parking 70 h × 9.28 = 649.74 (6.86 for a 16 h stay → hourly rate rises with long stays); intra-EU departure pax fee 48.84 and additional pax fee 6.50 (extra-EU 63.51 / 10; panel uses the higher), security 25.75 and bag 14.25 same; landing/departure 360.64; administrative fee 3.5%; standard handling 1,029.86; push back / tow bar 2 × 180 (G450; GLEX 250, panel 250); folder meteo 58.20; disbursement fee 379.50; agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2; storage 180, dish washing, laundry 443, taxi reservation, catering, limousine 195 not entered. By user decision parking to the safe side: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 9.29 per hour; ALEX and ELL 18.68, AFZ 21.53 (with ratio 9.28 / 6.86 = 1.353). FIFTH INVOICE 1.613 (30 Jul 2026; A6-FLH, LFPB–LIEO–LIRI, 25.07, cancelled trip): only 'dedicated Sky agent one hour late CXX fee' 150 + stamp duty 2 = 152. By user decision tick row 'Late Cancellation Fee - Dedicated Sky Agent (1 h)' 150 in bottom section, all groups. SIXTH INVOICE 1.758 (5 Aug 2026; T7-AFZ GL7T 53 t, EGGW–LIEO–LFMN, 30.07 19:35 – 31.07 08:35 local, 'parking hrs 11', 1 adult, intra-EU departure): landing = departure 663.88 (12.53 per t), parking 11 h × 13.68 = 150.52, intra-EU pax fees, administrative fee 3.5%, standard handling 1,747.68, terminal operating extension 550, waste disposal extra EU 190, push back 2 × 250, disbursement fee 461, invoice processing 10, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2; no extra EU surcharge (arrival from outside EU, departure intra-EU); limousine dispo 1,267.50 and crew 201.50, ice, catering, dish washing not entered. By user decision: AFZ handling 1,747.68, AFZ landing/departure 663.88; ALEX 488.32 and ELL 552.16 (linear between 34 t 360.64 and 53 t 663.88, safe side); waste disposal unit 190 (extra EU). CONTRACT (Sky Service handling agreement, article 5): 5.1 10% discount on standard handling (at article 2.1 airports; no discount on LIEO invoices — no discount in panel by user decision). 5.3.1 airport fee payment service at FBO airports (LIML/LIMC/LIPZ/LIPH/LIPX/LIRA/LIRN/LIRI/LIBD/LIBR): up to 300 € 7.95, 300–1,000 € 3%, over 1,000 € 3.5% — exactly the 'Commissione' on LIEO invoices (828.16 → 3% on 1.395). 5.3.2 at non-FBO airports 10% of third-party invoices — LIEO 'disbursement fee' 210 / 395 / 358 / 379.50 / 461 does not fit consistently (1.678 and 1.758 about 10%; 1.684 and 1.395 clearly higher, 1.138 lower; base unknown). By user decision flat fee removed in panel, disbursement 13.5% on airport fees (3.5% administrative + 10% disbursement fee); also applied to limousine (forceDisb). The 10% share charged on catering/laundry/limousine is deducted from the invoice together with catering in comparisons. Terminal operating extension 550 (user; appears linked to movements outside terminal hours, not stay: 1.684 21:11 arrival 400, 1.758 19:35 arrival / 08:35 departure 550). To ask Sky Services: disbursement fee base, administrative fee + disbursement fee on the same invoice, 10% handling discount. SEVENTH INVOICE 965 (16 Jun 2026; P4-BVY E135 25 t, LLBG–LIEO–OMDW, 08.06 03:45 – 11.06 17:47 local, 'parking hrs 84', no pax): landing/departure 184.50, parking 84 h 379.50 (4.52 per h), administrative fee 3% (748.50), standard handling overnight 831.50, terminal operating extension 2,800 (03:45 night arrival), lavatory 215, push back and towing 1 × 360, disbursement fee 496, invoice processing 10, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2, limousine 461.50. Handling: day 'standard handling' appears banded per ton (OWN 721.01 = 28.84 per t, FLH 1,029.86 = 30.29 per t, ELL 1,516.85 and AFZ 1,747.68 = 32.975 per t); 'standard handling overnight' with night movement OWN 831.50 (+15.3%), FLH 1,052.30 (+2.2%). By user decision handling at day price (OWN 721.01, FLH 1,029.86, ELL 1,516.85, AFZ 1,747.68), night difference in Surcharge as handler 'night' 15.4%, 21:00–06:00 (highest rate seen, so panel is not lower). Extra EU surcharge 15% on day handling (1,029.86 × 15% = 154.48, exact with invoice). Push back / towing one row per flight in basket: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 360; ALEX, ELL, AFZ 500. Terminal operating extension unit 550, with qty (1 unit per started hour outside operating hours; 6 units ≥ 2,800 on 965), in disbursement base (13.5%). Parking 4.52 per h (84 h) — panel kept at 9.29. ALEX group handling by user decision 42 t × 32.975 = 1,384.95 (ELL and AFZ per-ton rate; no invoice). By user decision (correction after 965): ALX1·KBI and OWN parking 6.57 per hour (OWN invoices 6.57 / 4.52); terminal operating extension per hour, with qty: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 400 (1.684 1 h 400, 965 7 h 2,800), ALEX, ELL, AFZ 550 (1.758). AVIAVIP (Argos VIP Private Handling, Rome) invoice 526100890 (31 Oct 2026; A6-FLH GLF4 33.59 t, OMDW–LIEO–LEMD, 7 Oct 12:47–14:08 UTC, 6 + 0 pax, commercial; EUR, no VAT): handling 2,037.96, service terminal 110, coordination 75, dedicated agent 150, pax assistance 85, fuel arrangement 30 (not entered), marshalling 75, permit 100, tarmac 6 × 12, porterage 8 × 14, duty stamp 2, credit administration fee 75, environmental fee 40, extra EU organic waste 2 × 130; airport fees 308.54 (landing 153.27, take off 153.27, parking 0, duty stamp 2) + 20% disbursement 61.70. USER DECISIONS (6 Nov 2026): AviaVIP separate handler, FLH only; disbursement 20% airport; items in basket (dedicated agent as supervision; tarmac 12 per arriving and departing pax; porterage 14 per bag with qty box; extra EU organic waste 130, default 2); landing and take-off at AviaVIP with its own invoice value 153.27 (Sky 360.64 from its own invoices; conflict noted); other airport rows same as Sky; fuel arrangement not entered.
